outcome: students' preferences for spousal presence during labor
students' preferences for spousal presence in the delivery room
students' views on the necessity of birth preparation courses
students' desire to attend birth preparation courses with spouses
cohort: The study included 302 1st and 4th-grade nursing and midwifery students from a faculty of health sciences.
finding: Most health sciences students expressed a desire for spousal support during pregnancy and delivery, considered birth preparation courses necessary, and wished to attend them with their spouses.
mod_finding: 86.4% of students wanted their spouse present during labor and 76.5% in the delivery room, with department of study affecting this preference (p<0.05) but class and gender not (p>0.05).
